what_this_is: The official Allen County CVB lodging directory, walked from its published sitemap because its /hotels/ index renders client-side. A lodging-keyword filter over the listing slug selects what to fetch; the listing page's OWN structured data decides whether the row is LODGING, OUT_OF_CURRENT_CATEGORY, NON_LODGING or UNDETERMINED. IDENTITY LEADS ONLY -- a CVB listing is not policy evidence and does not by itself admit a property to the census.
